Terms of Use

What you can expect when using SSC Compass to plan and track your studies.

Updated 7 November 2026

Using SSC Compass

Aurora Software Labs provides SSC Compass for personal study planning and progress tracking. If you are a minor, use the app with a parent or guardian’s permission. Keep your sign-in details private and use only an account you are authorised to access.

Study guidance and exam information

The app tracks your entries and estimates coverage, pace and possible score ranges. These figures depend on what you record and do not guarantee an exam outcome. Confirm exam dates, paper codes, reporting times, syllabus requirements and percentage rules with your school or the Maharashtra State Board. SSC Compass is an independent planner and is not an official board service.

Your records and backups

Your study records remain yours. You can export a backup in Settings. Browser storage can be cleared, internet access can interrupt sync, and services can be temporarily unavailable. Keep a copy of important records before changing devices or clearing browser data.

Responsible use

Use the app lawfully. Do not access another person’s account or data without permission, disrupt the service or attempt to bypass its access controls. Third-party services you choose to use, such as calendar apps, have their own terms.

App content and copyright

© 2026 Aurora Software Labs. Textbook titles, board references and third-party material belong to their respective rights holders. Any separately licensed software or material remains subject to its own licence.

Questions and updates

We may update these terms as the app changes. The date at the top shows when this version was published. For questions about SSC Compass, email Aurora Software Labs support.
